topic: APC 12x6 Sport propeller data and O.S. MAX-61FX operating points (EX-14f propeller-section fit and cross-checks)
note: Local copies live in the gitignored references/rc-propellers-12x6/. apcprop.com answers 403; the APC files came from the Wayback Machine. No measured APC Sport 12x6 exists at UIUC (nearest measured: Sport 11x6 and 11x7). Guide: docs/research/extra-300-realism/EX-14/README.md#ex-14f--propeller-section-camber.
